prompt: Camera locked off. The three steel prongs squeeze in round the white house with the red roof, settling their grip under its eaves. Then the claw begins to rise, drawing the house steadily upward and away from the heap of small houses, coins and rolled banknotes; it turns a few degrees on the cable as it climbs. A couple of coins under it slide and settle. The background shelves stay still and soft. Sound: a solenoid click as the claw closes, then the rising hum of the lift motor and coins slipping.
